from pocket_coffea.parameters.triggers import semileptonic_triggers
from pocket_coffea.lib.cuts import (
    trigger_pass,
    jet_multiplicity,
    btag_multiplicity,
)

# Analysis configuration
year = 2018
era = "UL"

# Retrieve HLT triggers for semileptonic primary dataset from parameters
hlt_triggers = semileptonic_triggers[year][era]

# Skim cuts (initial loose selection)
skim_cuts = [
    ("HLT_Semileptonic", trigger_pass(hlt_triggers)),
]

# Preselection cuts (tighter selection)
preselection_cuts = [
    (
        "JetGood_4j",
        jet_multiplicity(
            collection="JetGood",
            pt=30,
            n=4,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "BTag_2b",
        btag_multiplicity(n=2),
    ),
]

# Full configuration dictionary
config = {
    "year": year,
    "era": era,
    "skim": skim_cuts,
    "preselection": preselection_cuts,
}
